title: Pectin as a Multifunctional Therapeutic Platform for Ulcerative Colitis: Integrating Colonic Targeting, Microbiota Remodeling, and Antioxidant Synergy.
snippet: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a refractory intestinal disease characterized by chronic colonic mucosal inflammation, oxidative stress imbalance, and gut microbiota dysbiosis.
